title: try aborting before canceling 1st on dtor of ServerGoalHandle. by fujitatomoya · Pull Request #2953 · ros2/rclcpp · GitHub
body_rendered_text:
Description




Depends on ros2/rcl#1257


Fixes #2948 and #2757


Is this user-facing behavior change?



Yes.


before, on the destruction of ServerGoalHandle, it only tries to cancel the goal.

after, it tries to abort the goal 1st, and if not possible in the current state, it then falls back to cancel the goal.


the goal should be aborted if possible in the 1st place on destruction rather than canceled to match design spec as following.



ABORTED: The goal was terminated by the action server without an external request.


CANCELED: The goal was canceled after an external request from an action client.



https://design.ros2.org/articles/actions.html


Did you use Generative AI?



No

Pull Request Overview


This PR modifies the behavior of ServerGoalHandle destruction to prioritize aborting goals before attempting to cancel them, aligning with ROS2 design specifications. The change ensures that goals are marked as "ABORTED" (terminated by server) rather than "CANCELED" (terminated by client request) when appropriate.



Implements try_aborting() method to attempt goal abortion before cancellation


Updates destructor to try aborting first, then fall back to canceling if abortion isn't possible


Adds comprehensive test coverage for the new try_abort() functionality
